cohort: Neonates born at 22-25 weeks gestation at 776 U.S. centers participating in the Vermont Oxford Network (2006-2017)
finding: Major regional variation exists in the use of postnatal life support, antenatal corticosteroids, and cesarean delivery at 22 and 23 weeks gestation but not at 24 and 25 weeks.
mod_finding: The study examined regional differences in perinatal interventions, including cesarean delivery, among periviable gestations.
